programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When he last appeared on Dr. Phil, Kip’s brazen and outrageous tirade toward his 17-year-old stepdaughter, Tory, shocked audience members and viewers. But the married father of two refused to back down. When Tory broke down in tears, Kip finally agreed to find a calmer way to express his frustration. Just weeks later, Tory’s mother, Vicky, says the surly relationship has not only gotten worse, the hostility has escalated, and her patience is running thin. She says both Tory and Kip refuse to seek help, and now there is a new bombshell that is making their home life virtually unbearable. What does Kip say is his biggest issue with his stepdaughter? And, will this family finally agree to accept help and repair what’s left of their relationship? Then, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters. One of the girls has run away, and the other feels that he treats her like a slave. Can they resolve their disputes and come together as one? (FOLLOW UP FROM 9093)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a headline-grabbing case, 22-year-old Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, just hours after reports of an altercation between Sheena and her fiancé, Joe, now 48. Her death was ruled a suicide, but Sheena's parents refuse to believe that their daughter would take her own life -- they feel she was murdered, and that Joe may be responsible. In an effort to clear his name, Joe comes face to face with Sheena's mother and father, Kelly and David, on Dr. Phil's stage. What does Joe say happened on the night Sheena was last seen alive? And, how does his story differ from the one Kelly and David say they've pieced together? Listen to 911 calls from that night, including one from Sheena herself. Tune in and decide for yourself: Is there more to this story than Joe is revealing?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents, Kelly and David, say they believe their daughter was murdered, and have since been working relentlessly to reopen the investigation into her death, which is now under review. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Were there clues missed in the original investigation? Then, Joe says he believed Sheena was suicidal in the days leading up to her death -- so why did he leave her alone in the hotel room after a heated argument? Does his story add up? Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany and Sheka are not the only ones who accuse their ex-boyfriend, Erik, of constant lying and scamming throughout their relationships. Today, Dr. Phil hears from ex-girlfriends Torri and Courtney, and even Erik’s ex-wife, Martha, who all have different stories to share about Erik’s deceitful behavior. Now that Erik has been revealed as an alleged con man, will he decide to change his ways? Find out at the end of this dramatic part 2.

programme.desc: Jeremy owns his own funeral escort company but says he’s being falsely accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been leaked online, received millions of views, and as a result, he is being victimized in his community and misrepresented in the media – and now, he and his attorney want to set the record straight. Dr. Phil meets Jeremy and takes a closer look into components of his business, including his motorcycle, uniform and badge. Is Jeremy “playing cop” or just doing his job? And, what’s on Jeremy’s duty belt? You won’t want to miss part one of this two-part show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Jeremy, a funeral escort, who is being accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. But, Jeremy says the world has it all wrong and wants to clear his name. Today, Dr. Phil meets a funeral director who has worked with Jeremy for seven years, as well as someone who’s been following his story from afar. What do they have to say? Plus, to help prove his intention is not to impersonate a police officer, Jeremy requested a polygraph test. What does the test reveal? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil once again exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge of committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live with the fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Joanna says her rage is scaring her son. Michelle’s rage has driven her to slap her child and hit her with a wooden spoon. Lisa admits to pulling her daughter’s hair when she gets angry. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.desc: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Honey has taken a death-defying leap out of a car doing 40 kms an hour to chase down a cat. Somehow the spoodle has survived but just how serious are her injuries? Owner, Ilana is suffering enormous guilt that she didn’t have the family’s pride and joy safety strapped in the car. Watch for the cat hating spoodle’s reaction when she hears her archenemies out the back of the Bondi clinic.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour. What has the huge python swallowed that is now threatening to kill him? This a case of truth being stranger then fiction.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan’s horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is about to be confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. Twelve-year old Elliot’s much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive, cancerous tumour. But surgery on such a pint-sized patient is going to be a real challenge. Will Pinot pull through or will a young girl be shattered?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A fascinating Sphynx cat has become a sex-pest after being driven mad by her raging hormones. Scott goes to Sheffield to meet a remarkable teenage animal activist and winds up treating a badly behaved meerkat.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: In this Vet on the Hill Christmas special, Scott goes head to head with one of Santa’s helpers and finds out that wrangling reindeers is hard work, a young family have their Christmas wish come true and a special party for six puppies that Scott helped bring into the world.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well ...try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pearl was at her regular hairdressing appointment when she started bleeding internally. Now the pampered poodle may have minutes to live and Chris is her only hope.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Lucu has been attacked by a paralysis tick and the poison is rapidly shutting down her system. A round the clock watch is needed to keep this innocent victim alive. But will it be enough?

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode a critically ill kangaroo infant has Andrew and the young joey’s rescuer worried for its life. Dr Romi has her hand full with eight lively puppies, but will they get a clean bill of health?

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: A chocolate binge has left whippet Dash in danger of a fatal heart attack. Labrador Carson didn’t just snack on yoghurt, he’s devoured the entire plastic container, and Ralph is in extreme pain after a nasty encounter with a fish hook.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Rescue cat Janet has a fused jaw and can’t eat properly. Scott performs radical surgery but will it work? A school visit to help goats, Jack and Jill and a haircut for Scott turns into a consultation for the barber’s beloved fluffy white dog.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A three legged Labrador has had a shocking start to life but it looks like things could get even worse for the loveable Marcus, Scott needs to find out why 2 year old Mabel is walking like a geriatric and a chubby hedgehog goes on a fitness campaign.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer and will she ever be able to fly?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emotional case for Chris as he fights to save one of the clinic’s favourite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now Bluebell is the victim of a hit run accident and all the staff at Bondi are directly affected.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It’s all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode delicate surgery has Andrew anxious for Sally the cow’s future. And why is doctor Romi so over the moon?

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out. And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked the five year old and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of Tigger’s injuries.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott is confronted with one of the most shocking cases of neglect he has ever seen, a challenging total hip replacement for a tiny 5 pound Chihuahua and a chaotic cat invasion.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us its like “ a third testicle swinging in the wind.” But when it comes to surgery it’s no laughing matter for Chris.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate. Lucky to survive, he has now endured seven operations to try to fix the gaping hole in his mouth. All have failed and time is running out. Chronic infections are now destroying his quality of life. Like Boris, his owner Jess is refusing to give up. She’s written to Chris looking for one last chance. The surgery will be the first of its type ever performed in Australia. Eight thousand dollars needs to be raised and Chris is prepared to go all the way for Boris!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone and end up in serious trouble. What can Dr Chris come up with to tame the savage terrier?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: In this special episode, city boy Scott heads to Wales to find out if he’s cut out to handle life as a country vet. It’s a baptism of fire, as he wrestles a feisty ram, helps save a foal with a life threatening hernia and gets up and close and personal with a prize bull.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott meets a brave little rescue pup with a heartbreaking list of problems. Why isn't Pippa able to play with her new family? Scott is under pressure with an extra special patient, and terrier Wellum’s extra special problem.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: 6 month old German Shepherd, Gypsy hasn't been able to keep any food down for weeks and is losing weight rapidly. But getting to the bottom of the problem is proving impossible as the petrified patient refuses to let anybody examine her. Lisa is seriously concerned about what has happened to this young pup. Will it be a happy ending for Gypsy?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A critically ill swan has been found caught up in a soccer net in a suburban backyard. The bird is emaciated and running out of time. Has Chris arrived in time to save the swan from certain death?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Elderly cat Bosley has a lump in his abdomen but surgery results in an unexpected drama. Limping dog Coco needs an operation to save her knees. Scott's gym session turns into a consult when he discovers his trainer’s Sharpei needs a facelift.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A brave little Shih Tzu faces a huge battle, a plot to sweet talk Scott into taking on a clinic cat and a flying Beagle that could be grounded for life.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A story that is sure to touch your heart. Poppy is a Fijian native dog whose nose was cut off in a horrific hunting accident. In the north of Fiji there are no full time vets. Volunteers at Animals Fiji have managed to keep her alive with donations raised in Australia. Now Chris has gone to Fiji to bring the little girl back to Australia for major reconstructive surgery and hopefully a whole new life with an adopted family. Unless something is done, Poppy will always face serious infections and be shunned because of her shocking brutal injuries.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: One year-old Hero has been vomiting all day and his owners are worried he’s been up to his old tricks eating rocks from their backyard. Can Lisa help the naughty Labrador pass the rock or will he be forced to have major surgery?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A doting owner and her tiny terrier are both fighting serious health problems. Why does poor Harry the tabby cat need a sex change operation and Scott discovers a rare eye condition in a sweet natured sproodle.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott heads to the Isle of Wight to help with a risky procedure on a rare and beautiful 21-year-old Bengal tiger and then performs drastic surgery on a donkey with a shocking sinus problem. Back in London, Scott tries to help a 2-year-old Labrador that walks like a geriatric.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Jess, has wanted a dog for as long as she can remember, but living with her parents and renting has thrown up several ‘road blocks’. Jess wants a dog that her mum will cope with, and that will get along with her other passion….her horses.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Julien & Nicolette have three daughters, and Keira, 4, has an irrational fear of dogs. Dr. Lisa advises that the best thing to do might be to get a dog. Will the cure work and what special issues do three young girls put in her way?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: A big-hearted family needs Lisa's help to find them their first dog.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Bubbly single mum Edwina is looking for a dog to grow up with her two little girls, but she's torn when it comes to choosing between two adorable pooches.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Mitsy may appear to be normal but there is something terribly wrong. The rescue kitten is struggling to walk since being micro chipped and her foster family is worried that a misplaced chip may have caused spinal damage. Andrew Marchevsky is left with no other option but to operate. Will the surgery restore Mitzi's ability to walk or will she be made permanently worse?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is answering a call for help from May Dodd, who runs an animal shelter for abandoned donkeys. One of her residents, Dusty, has developed a very strange walk. May is worried if nothing can be done to help Dusty walk normally again, the donkey’s diminished quality of life that will be unbearable. Can Chris get to the bottom of this mysterious problem and save Dusty?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott tries to help a Spanish rescue cat with a chronic eye condition. A heartbroken young owner finds out the shocking news about her puppy, and can big hearts save two neglected canaries?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott and Emma fall in love with a fox that just can’t make it in the wild, Hugo the Bull Mastiff has just found a loving new home but his luck may have run out, and Scott has a testing time in the country with some exotic patients.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: There’s no time to rest as Chris is sent straight out to help a pregnant cow through a difficult labor. And his midwife duties are not over yet.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris’ country locum at the Kyabram Veterinary Clinic continues and some of his patients are a little out of the ordinary. Harriet the Bearded Dragon is a much loved resident of the local Fauna Park. Her Keeper Hannah is concerned about a lump that has suddenly appeared on the dragon's leg. The worry is that it could be cancer. Chris decides removing the lump is the only option, but on the operating table, things go horribly wrong. Can Chris save Harriet?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: At the Australian reptile park, Operations Manager Tim Faulkner is responding to an in-house emergency. Cameron the Cormorant has swallowed a mystery object, and it’s caused a dangerous swelling in the little bird's throat. Tim needs to remove the object urgently or Cameron may choke to death.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris faces a porker of a decision as he helps a young family choose a very unusual pet – a Mini Pig. A wrong decision could cause chaos, so Chris needs to make sure that the family is ready for the challenges of owning a little piggie.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A five-month-old puppy needs emergency surgery after a freak accident and a baffling case for Scott as he tries to find out why a young poodle-cross is suddenly losing the use of her legs.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott has to deliver some devastating news to his sister-in-law Maz about her puppy Branston, a baby budgerigar needs help and a cat with a weird growth on it's head.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris's holiday in far north Queensland is interrupted as word of the visiting Vet has spread like wildfire. First stop is the Cairns Rainforest Station Nature Park where Chris has been asked to help a crook crocodile. A few months ago, Agro broke his jaw biting down on a steel fence. Chris needs to examine the injury, but everyone is on high alert for a very good reason. Not so long ago, Agro killed 9 other crocs that shared his pond. Is Chris biting off more than he can chew?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ten-week-old Nala has been rushed to SASH with an extremely swollen face. It is so bad that she can barely see. The little Golden Retriever needs to stay in overnight for observation, but her protective owner isn’t willing to part with her baby. Will this new Mum follow doctor’s orders or take a risk with her sick puppy?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: In this episode, Scott deals with a liver disease scare for celebrity Dachshund Gigi; finds an astonishing cause of a lump in the stomach of a Maine Coon cat, and there’s a miracle recovery for the victim of a horrific car accident.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott is called to see why an elderly dog has suddenly collapsed; Jack the Springer Spaniel needs massive lumps removed from his shoulder; and a pet guinea pig with a bladder stone.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Gizmo was saved from death row by Denise from PAWS rescue. The little Shih Tzu is suffering chronic ear infections, and for the last three months since his rescue, Chris and Denise have tried unsuccessfully to treat the debilitating problem. Chris is now being forced to take extreme measures or Gizmo will never be able to find a new forever home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A sudden problem with Jemima’s hind leg has put an abrupt stop to her full throttle lifestyle. The shorthaired pointer has shattered her cruciate ligament, and without surgery she will never be able to walk normally again. Can Andrew Marchevsky repair Jemima’s badly damaged leg?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott performs life saving surgery on a tiny pet hedgehog; naughty Colin swallows a dangerous bone; two elderly cats need urgent treatment; and a nail trim for a pet parrot.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott helps a young kitten who’s fallen from a high door; Toby has an embarrassing problem; Poppy is struggling with painful hips and Lenny needs urgent ear surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to Victoria in response to an SOS from a young volunteer at Safe Haven Horse rescue. 11 year old Tash has fallen in love with a surrendered appaloosa gelding, Charlie. Tash is worried about a huge lump growing on Charlie’s eye and she’s hoping Chris can save her much loved Charlie.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is at the Hunter Valley to check on one of the zoo’s oldest residents, Mal. The 30-year-old spider monkey has a huge lump growing inside his mouth that has started to bleed. Chris needs to examine the lump to determine if it’s an easily treatable infection or a life-threatening tumor. What’s the diagnosis for this much loved monkey?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott treats Bulldog sisters with the same shocking bladder problem; a working holiday in Wales sees Scott perform extraordinary surgery on a cow, and all the dogs vie for his attention at the local agricultural show.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott nurses a brave neglected rescue dog back to health and finds him a home; New vet Phoebe takes on surgery on her first day; A 100 year old couple start a new family.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Mini pig James’s obsessive digging has got him in serious trouble with the local authorities. If he doesn’t stop digging massive holes in the park, the council may ban him. Can Chris solve this porker of a problem?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this special episode… Chris travels to Thailand to work with a wildlife crusader. Edwin Wiek and his team care for hundreds of homeless animals, many of them victims of abuse. Urgent medical attention is needed for patients ranging from elephants to monkeys to a sunbear. Chris also witnesses what happens when Thailand’s desperate elephants run out of food and a place to live. It’s a touching and sometimes confronting journey.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Lisa faces a tough challenge trying to find the right dog for a teenager who's been wary of dogs all her life.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Dr Lisa searches for the right dog for a busy young family.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Dr. Lisa helps a young couple to find their very first dog.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Lisa meets big-hearted pet lovers who already have a cat and one rescue dog and are ready to take on a second dog.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Badger needs surgery for a massive chest lump that’s affecting his breathing; little Cookie has developed an alarming snort; the search to find the owners of a lost kitten; and Scott adopts chickens.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott performs knee surgery on a much loved Boston terrier, Dumpy Dylan goes on a weight loss program, some fiesta felines put Scott's new vet Phoebe to the test and Scott's own dog needs surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A medical mystery for Chris as he tries to diagnose what’s wrong with a beautiful five month old border collie. puppy. Even Sash specialist surgeon Andrew is forced to look overseas for answers to this rare and baffling case. Plus we meet the newest member of the Bondi Vet family….Lisa’s tiny son, Hudson. Does he get on with his four legged brothers? Watch and smile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Another remarkable journey for Chris. This time he travels to the remote parts of northern Kenya to see the work of a brave Aussie zoo keeper fighting to save some of the world’s most endangered animals. In this extraordinary episode, Chris treats an orphaned baby rhino, takes cover from gunfire as an anti poaching squad hunts down a killer and saves the life of a badly mauled goat. Plus the Bondi Vet meets some amazing women and finds out how their beautiful beads are saving wildlife and gets involved with a crazy jumping competition with some Masai warriors.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: Miracle Maker
programme.desc: “The Miracle Maker is coming!” If any town is in need of a miracle, it’s Woodhaven, a tiny town hanging on the edge of the American frontier. It’s nearly Christmas, but it’s hardly a season of celebration. Work is scarce, money is tight, love is lagging, and spirits are down. Maybe the Miracle Maker can turn things around. The town anxiously waits for someone magnificent who can change their lives. But the ragged traveler who appears isn’t what anyone expects—except for one small silent boy and a precocious little girl. It seems this man can barely take care of himself, let alone fulfill the dreams of others. But miracles can come in all shapes and sizes—and sometimes from unexpected places. Your entire family will love this Christmas tale of hope, love, and miracles.

programme.title: Blueprint To The Heart
programme.desc: An interior designer trying to save her home renovation show needs to apply her successful, upscale "fixer upper" home renovation strategy to her blue collar carpenter by making the sweet but disheveled guy her next fixer upper project.

programme.title: Love In Aruba
programme.desc: A lonely teacher (Amber) is hired by Connor, the single father of a struggling student. She is to tutor his daughter Macey (age 10) over a summer while they travel for his work. As Amber helps Macey, she sees glimpses of what’s missing in the family’s life. Their grand destinations are filled with rich items and potential rewarding business deals, but it’s missing heart. Amber’s influence fills the void and brings Macey and Connor together. With it, Amber starts to fall in love with Connor, but can he see her as anything beyond the hired help?

programme.desc: American doctor Ivy Miller lives in Bali, working at a charitable health clinic. When a billionaire benefactor named Dylan Donnelly arrives, Ivy is less than impressed. He is only interested in making himself look better by appearing charitable. Ivy is happy when he goes on his way, but then an accident injures one of Dylan’s trusted advisors, Blake. Dylan insists Ivy stay at Dylan’s lavish estate in Bali to care for Blake until he’s well.

programme.title: A Very Country Christmas
programme.desc: When Country superstar Zane Gunther is looking to escape the chaos of fame, he retreats to the small town where he had fond childhood memories. There he meets a single mother, Jeanette Williams, who’s trying to make the best life for her and her daughter, Quinn. With little time for herself, let alone romance, will working with Zane on the local Christmas Concert be just what Jeannette needs to open her heart to the possibility of love?

programme.desc: A busy surgeon heads back home to celebrate her father becoming mayor. But after a chance encounter with the town's only doctor-and most eligible bachelor-she witnesses true compassion which might be the prescription this doctor needs.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: When Sarah Goldman, a lovely young school teacher in Chicago, wants to please her parents, she invents a boyfriend whom she believes will be the man of her mother's dreams. The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.

As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.

programme.title: Caterpillar 365C & Caterpillar 385C Excavators Loading Coal on 4 Axle Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s powerful ground footage, we’re deep inside a massive coal mining operation, watching two legendary machines—the Caterpillar 365C and Caterpillar 385C hydraulic excavators—working side by side to load coal onto 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks. - These machines, operated by highly skilled professionals, deliver fast and accurate loading cycles, keeping up with the demands of a non-stop production environment. The teamwork between the two excavators and the constant flow of dump trucks showcases perfect coordination, machine power, and mining efficiency at its finest.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Caterpillar 777F Dumpers In Huge Quarry
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we’re inside a massive aggregate quarry, witnessing the unmatched performance of the Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader loading Caterpillar 777F dump trucks with blasted materials. - This footage captures not just the raw power of the machines, but also the refined skill of the operator, the tight coordination between the loader and the dumpers, and the efficient production cycles that keep the quarry running at full speed. - Every bucket is on point. Every pass is fast. This is how top-tier aggregate operations maintain productivity, consistency, and precision—day in, day out.

programme.title: DRONE FOOTAGE! Caterpillar D9T Bulldozer Rehabilitating an Old Mine
programme.desc: Welcome back to the Mega Machines channel, where the world’s most powerful machines reshape massive landscapes. In today’s stunning 4K drone video, we fly above a huge old mining site, capturing cinematic aerial footage of a Caterpillar D9T bulldozer working nonstop to rehabilitate and restore the former mine area. - This is heavy equipment power seen from the sky.

programme.title: Caterpillar 365B, 352F & Liebherr 964 Loading Fleet Of Trucks At Massive Mine
programme.desc: Today, we're deep inside one of the biggest open-pit mining operations, where an amazing team of three powerful excavators—the legendary Caterpillar 365B, the high-tech Caterpillar 352F, and the robust Liebherr 964—are working side-by-side to load overburden onto a constant flow of Mercedes-Benz and MAN 4-axle dump trucks.

programme.title: Three Caterpillar 352F & Liebherr 964 Excavators Working At Massive Mining Site
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we’re inside a massive active coal mine, watching a powerful fleet of three heavy-duty hydraulic excavators—two Caterpillar 352F and one Liebherr 964—working non-stop to load coal onto 4-axle Mercedes-Benz and MAN dump trucks. - These giant machines are being expertly operated, with each pass calculated to maximize load and minimize time. You’ll witness top-tier coordination, skilled operators, and incredibly productive loading cycles in real-world mining conditions.

programme.title: Caterpillar 374D Excavator Loading Massive Mercedes & MAN Trucks
programme.desc: In this episode, you’ll witness the incredible performance of the Caterpillar 374D hydraulic excavator as it dominates the mine face. This massive machine is tasked with removing overburden—the heavy layers of soil and rock that must be cleared before coal extraction can begin.

programme.title: White Cat 385C Excavator Loading Coal On Mercedes & MAN Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we’re at a massive coal mine watching a stunning white Caterpillar 385C Hydraulic Excavator in action! This powerful machine is loading coal onto 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks with precision and speed.

programme.title: Constr. Site In Action, Cat 395, Cat 777, Cat 14G Grader & Cat D8R
programme.desc: Welcome back to the Mega Machines channel, where the biggest construction and mining machines work together on massive real-world projects. In today’s video, we are inside a huge construction site, watching a full production cycle—from drilling and blasting, to excavation and hauling, all the way to dumping and embankment building.

programme.title: Brand New Cat 395 Excavator Loading Cat 777 Dumpers | Massive Earthworks
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we’re on a huge construction site where preparations are underway for the development of a massive industrial factory. At the center of this large-scale earthmoving operation is the brand new Caterpillar 395 hydraulic excavator, performing with incredible speed and precision. - The 395 is seen loading Caterpillar 777 rigid dump trucks with heavy material, clearing the area and shaping the land for the upcoming construction phases. programme.title: Relocating The Caterpillar D9T Dozer, Liebherr 974 & Liebherr 954
programme.desc: In today’s heavy haul video, we follow a full relocation operation, transporting three massive machines from one job site to the next nearby project using a heavy-duty trailer and a MAN TGX 530 special transport truck.

programme.title: Mining Site Full Of Caterpillar & Liebherr Excavators And Fleet Of Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s video, we are inside a busy coal mining site, watching a non-stop operation where multiple excavators load coal and overburden onto a fleet of 4-axle trucks.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Cat 777F Dumpers With Aggregates
programme.desc: In today’s video, we’re inside a huge aggregate quarry, watching an impressive, high-production operation where a Caterpillar 992K wheel loader loads blasted material onto Caterpillar 777F dumpers with speed, precision, and nonstop rhythm.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Giant Cat 5090B Front Shovel Excavator Loading Gravel On Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, capturing the raw power and precision of the Caterpillar 5090B Front Shovel Excavator. This giant machine is seen loading gravel from a deposit area onto a fleet of 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks, preparing materials for ongoing operations across the mine.

programme.title: Liebherr 984 Excavator Loading Caterpillar 777 Dumpers Drone View
programme.desc: At the heart of today’s footage is the giant Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator, operating at full production. From the air, the true scale of this machine becomes clear as it loads blasted material with smooth, powerful cycles.

programme.title: Extreme 4K Highway Construction Full Of Heavy Equipment In Action!
programme.desc: In today’s construction video, we are on a huge highway construction site, packed with Caterpillar and Liebherr excavators, a Cat motor grader, a bulldozer, and a fleet of 4-axle trucks—all working together in a fast-moving, high-productivity operation.

programme.title: Liebherr 984 & Cat 395 Loading Overburden Onto 4 Axle Trucks

People often ask us, 'Why do you return to Cedros Island?' The answer is straightforward: the fishing is absolutely ridiculous almost every single time. Our Stoked on Fishing charter makes a point of showing up in the middle of October for a reason. That reason? It's all about the variety of species available to catch, starting with yellowfin tuna, dorado, halibut, and the elusive Mr. Yellowtail. It's game time - let's go fishing in Baja!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank: Part Two
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.

programme.desc: Clint Harrison is a gunslinger who has been running from vengeful foes for years. He returns to the town he once abandoned and discovers his family has moved away to escape his bad reputation. Seeking redemption, he tracks them down and becomes caught in a violent conflict between farmers and a ruthless rancher willing to kill for land.

programme.title: The Executioner of God
programme.desc: A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

Tepepa, a hero of the Revolution, is curious about the doctor’s motives. The chilling answer: to kill him himself. A deadly game of cat and mouse begins between Tepepa and the ruthless police chief, Cascorro.

programme.title: Night of the Serpent
programme.desc: In a corrupt Mexican village, Commander Hernandez and his men plot to steal young Manuel’s inheritance. When the broken ex-gunslinger Luke is drawn into their scheme by the revolutionary Pancho, betrayal and vengeance ignite in a tale of greed and redemption.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Nicola Bellizzi returns to Naples, after spending six years in a juvenile detention centre, determined to get out of his outcast status and become a lawyer. In the neighbourhood, Gaetano, known as Core e' Fierro, is the absolute boss of the guapperia. A clash takes place between the two young men; but the behaviour of Nicola, who defends Gaetano from the commissioner Ajossa who has caught them duelling, gives rise to a deep friendship between the two. After many denials, driven by necessity, Nicola agrees to become a guappo in turn during an initiation at the secret court to which he is introduced by Core e' Fierro. Lucia, Gaetano's woman, feels attracted to Nicola, but the two repress their desire. Ajossa wants to get his hands on Gaetano and sets a trap for Lucia, inducing her to yield to him in order to save her lover, so that the latter, in order to avenge the offence, will make a mistake.

programme.desc: College stud and a famed band player Ajay is introduced to the stunning daughter of a business tycoon named Ayesha. Ajay is smitten by Ayesha's modesty and coyness and what starts off as a mere acquaintance soon turns into full-blown love affair. But Ayesha's father Mr. Verma is unhappy with their union and his associate Mr. Chopra takes advantage of his discontentment. Mr. Chopra, wanting to take over Mr. Verma's fortune, suggests his own son for Ayesha and brainwashes him about Ajay. The situation takes a deadly turn when a hit-man is appointed to end Ajay's life. But seeing Ajay's aggressive stubbornness to be with Ayesha, Mr. Verma gives him a challenge, to find his lady-love within a day or leave from her life forever. Ajay accepts the challenge, unaware that a bigger conspiracy is at work to tear them apart once and for all.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam responds to a call from frantic parents whose son has fallen through a glass window and is bleeding to death. A father son weekend becomes a Dad’s worst nightmare when his little boy is struggling to breathe. Leonard and Nicola help a grandmother in excruciating pain with a fractured hip. A young man suffering a rare condition has Doddsy on high alert. Mike and Eamon are confronted with a shocking Martial Arts injury, and Risky stops by with a special little visitor.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Glenice rushes to the rescue of a scared elderly man who's been trapped in his bathtub for days after a suspected fall. Cam is called out to help a tiny patient in big trouble. A grave situation for Taz and Amanda when they’re called to an accident in an unlikely setting. Nat and Leonard help a nurse who has crashed her car into a bush and is showing worrying signs of amnesia, and later, Nat wins herself an unexpected admirer.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Al and Doddsy are called to a rodeo to help a retired cowboy who’s returned to the ring with disastrous results. Glenice helps a young couple fighting to save their 6-year-old daughter who’s suffering from a rare and shocking disease. Amanda and Taz get a lesson on making a marriage last from a couple who have been married for more than 60 years, and an unpredictable patient with a head injury has Cullen on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Carina and Doddsy are on high alert as they rush to the scene of an horrific car crash, where a young man’s life is hanging in the balance. Amanda and Leonard help an 11-year-old girl with a heartbreaking story, after a suspected overdose leaves her lifeless on the floor. Cam steps in when a distraught woman is convinced she’s about to lose her husband. Eamon and Mike turn on the charm for their elderly patient, and is Leonard’s baby about to make an early entrance?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Will Mike and Eamon need to break down doors to get to a possible stroke patient, who’s been collapsed inside his locked home for days? Cullen fights to save the life of a man who’s choking to death on a piece of ham. Taz and Amanda win over a volatile patient, who reveals a hidden talent as Carina and Doddsy are called to a case that hits close to home - a fellow paramedic who has been attacked on the job.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam’s young patient is pregnant with twins and showing signs of going into early labour. Will her twins arrive in the back of the ambulance? Mike and Eamon are also on baby watch as they help a young mother-to-be who has a scare at early stages of her pregnancy. A puzzling case for Nat and Leonard as they treat a patient with confusing symptoms, and a little boy with big dreams of becoming a paramedic pays a visit to two of his heroes, before Amanda celebrates a special milestone.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A heartbreaking story, as flight paramedic Ray joins a massive ocean rescue mission in treacherous conditions near Victoria’s Twelve Apostles, where a tourist has been swept out to sea. Single Responder Glenice is first at the scene of an horrific car crash where multiple patients need her attention. Taz and Amanda are called to a man suffering severe chest pains that has already survived three heart attacks. Will today be his forth?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: An agitated burns victim makes for an anxious flight for Ray and the helicopter crew. A baby’s allergic reaction has Mike and Eamon working their charm on both bub and an anxious Mum. Amanda and Leonard team-up for a night shift, and rush to a 72-year-old with chest pains who thinks his time is up. A trip down memory lane for Doddsy and Glenice, before they rush to help a critically ill bus driver on the toughest journey of his life.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A man collapses in the hospital café. Luckily, it’s next to the ED, but Dr Jonathan fears the man’s luck is running out. Dr Laura and Dr Mark bend over backwards to perform what should be a routine procedure on a woman with a dislocated hip. Dr Emma is concerned that a young man with numbness down one side of his body may have a life-changing illness. A motorbike rider has horrific injuries after crashing through a wire fence. Dr Caitlin and Dr Michael fear the man might lose his foot.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A surfer has a heart attack out in the water. Dr Caitlin and Dr Martin are not sure they can save him. Dr Mya reassures a mum with agonising leg injuries after the woman was squashed between the motorbike she was on and a 4WD. A teen with a machete wound to his arm has Dr Michael on alert. Dr Mark and Dr Tessa treat self-described ‘idiot’ Paul, who has fallen ten metres from a tree, with a chainsaw. A footballer knows which bones he’s broken, but not how he did it.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Mya’s stabbing victim is hanging on to life with uncontrolled bleeding. Dr David’s patient has potential spinal injuries after crashing onto his head during a mountain bike race. Dr Emma and Dr Jonathan are worried about a great-grandmother with disastrous chest injuries from a car accident. A pregnant mother has Dr George and Dr Caitlin concerned, as the woman hasn’t felt her baby move at all. To help the doctors de-stress, Milo the dog proves a hit during bring your dog to work day.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A quad-bike accident has a race-track worker needing all of Dr Michelle’s skills, but his X-ray results confuse everyone. Dr Emma has a young man’s life in her hands as he bleeds profusely from the throat. Dr Catriona is worried a tradie might lose his sight after he comes in with terrible injuries from a workplace accident. Dr George and Dr Rosie need to electrocute the heart of a father of two. Dr Michelle challenges Dr Mya to an 8km fun run but Mya doesn’t fill Michelle with confidence.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Jonathan’s car crash patient, a nursing student, has such terrible injuries her life hangs in the balance. Dr George’s truck accident victim needs two tourniquets above the knee to stop severe blood loss, but if they don’t come off he’ll lose his leg. Dr Mya’s special brand of TLC helps a young woman in physical and emotional pain. Dr Michael is impressed with an 81-year-old man who walked in to hospital on his broken leg, but the man’s dizzy spells has Michael worried.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A car crash survivor needs litres of blood, but Dr Martin is struggling to find a vein that hasn’t collapsed. Dr Mya is juggling patients like balls in the air and hoping not to drop any. Dr Michael examines a motorbike rider with a damaged shoulder and smashed leg. He wants his mum, so ‘Mama Bear’ Gina steps in. Dr Andrew has a wee problem being understood, but the soon-to-be-Aussie has bigger issues with a young footballer showing signs of spinal and internal injuries after a hard tackle.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Ebony and Dr Jonathan are on high alert as their patient could turn on them without warning. Dr Mya and Dr David treat a young woman with a broken jaw who is at risk of choking after falling face-first off, her horse and is in a world of pain. Dr Luke and Dr Emma are grateful for a good early sign from a motorbike rider who collided with a car, but alarms soon ring out. Dr Tessa is astounded by a bush remedy used when a farm worker on a forklift fell in high winds, cracking his head.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Emma are on high alert for a mother-to-be who is paralysed and unresponsive from a suspected stroke. Every second counts as Dr Bjorn and Dr Martin’s critically injured patient clings to life after a one-tonne camper trailer rolled over him. A confused motorbike rider remembers nothing and feels no pain while Dr Michael searches for chest, spinal and brain injuries. Pregnant Dr Jana needs a covid-free room to drink water, then is back to re-set an artist’s broken wrists.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Sarah must numb a nursing student’s hand to clean her mangled fingers, but the woman won’t let her because she’s terrified of needles. Dr Ali suspects a former war correspondent has serious spinal injuries after the man rolled his car. First-time dads Dr Michael and Dr Luke swap nappy tales before it’s all hands on deck for a motorcycle rider with multiple fractures. Dr Emma and Nurse Emma fear a stoic 79-year-old grandmother might lose her leg after she was hit by a car crossing the street.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Trauma patients pour through the doors. Dr Jason searches a teen’s mud-encrusted body for breaks after the dirt-bike rider crashed in a race. Nurse Elle and Dr Steve suspect a cyclist with a badly broken leg is being far too brave, masking other injuries. Dr Mya and Dr Matt fear a young tradie could have a life-altering spinal injury after a fall at work. Dr Michelle puts lunch on hold as she and Dr Jonathan examine a 67-year-old motorbike rider for broken bones.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Australia’s ambulance crews are there for everyday people having their worst days. Natalie and Leonard comfort a schoolboy who’s fallen metres out of a tree on his head. MICA paramedic Cam fights to save a much-loved dad in cardiac arrest. Matt and the flight crew race to a fellow paramedic who’s been bitten by a deadly brown snake, but reaching the isolated patient is almost impossible. Mike and Eamon support a young woman with a debilitating yet all-too-common condition.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Everyday thousands of calls come through to Victoria’s ambulance service from desperate people. Nat and Leonard head to a hotel roof-top pool, where a romantic escape in the city ends in disaster for a young mum. Eamon and Mike race to a traumatised child attacked by a dog. Steve and Emily grow increasingly worried about an elderly nun who could be having a stroke. Flight paramedic Matt dashes to the high country as an off-duty firefighter’s life hangs in the balance after a motorbike crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Two million calls for help are made in Victoria every year. In rugged bushland, a dad with his two kids on board has crashed one hundred metres down a ravine. Getting the injured driver out is a nightmare and the teetering wreck could crush the rescuers. Mike and Eamon fear the worst as they rush to a teenager who has plummeted through a skylight, and can Emily and Steve save an elderly man who is on the brink of a cardiac arrest?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A call is made every twelve seconds, from people across Victoria desperate for help. MICA Paramedic Cullen races to a young woman slipping into a potentially fatal diabetic coma. She’s so sick, any treatment Cullen gives could make things worse. A little girl’s terrifying seizure has Glenice on high alert. It’s the 8-year-old’s first attack and she’s unresponsive. Marlie and Tanie treat a skateboard rider who’s crashed at high speed without a helmet. Mike and Eamon reach a fun career milestone.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every twelve seconds across Victoria, a call for help is made to emergency services. Simon and Michaela perform a high-risk intervention on a brain tumour patient having seizures. Cullen races to a man trapped in a wrecked car after an horrific crash. Nat and Leonard help a ninety-one-year-old woman who fell hard while helping a neighbour. Alarm bells ring for Emily and Steve as a man with chest pain worsens dramatically. A young stabbing victim has Tanie and Marlie on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: On the frontline, paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. Cullen faces every parent’s nightmare as a six-year-old child is hit by a car. Simon and Michaela battle to help a man whose pacemaker is misfiring, sending agonising shocks through his system. Tanie and Marlie fear for their safety as a patient suddenly turns violent. A food delivery rider comes close to disaster and an emergency airlift for a thrill-seeker motorcycle mum who’s catapulted off a cliff.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 38-year-old man has suffered a massive attack while enjoying a day off with his wife in their spa. Cullen fears he could die before they get him to hospital. A teen footballer has collapsed after a bruising tackle and could have a serious head injury. Eamon and Mike’s charm offensive might not work with feisty 94-year-old Miffy. A man has collapsed in a supermarket and a language barrier makes Steve and Emily’s job even harder.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 76-year-old motorbike rider suffers catastrophic injuries after a terrifying crash into trees. Veterans Al and Cam race to a lung cancer survivor gasping for air. Emily and Steve help an entertaining patient with mystery arm pain. Mike joins the ‘fun’ ambulance to help seriously ill children escape from their daily challenges. Glenice and Doddsy are called to a bizarre accident, and a heavily bleeding cyclist is enrolled in the Marlie school of safety.
